claim_or_fact: Merged new OT.02 consists of former Rietgors 762 ha, Fuut 367 ha and Kievit 373 ha; total 1502 ha.
intended_use: Historical design-area context and component stratification
guardrail: Do not use 1502 ha as current affected compaction area or assume it is the latest administrative area.

claim_or_fact: Onderbemaling Tollebeek OT.02 is listed at 1497 ha.
intended_use: Current administrative system-area benchmark until superseded by reviewed current geometry
guardrail: Administrative area is not the same as affected area and is not an exact geometry checksum.

claim_or_fact: OT.02 target surface-water level is NAP -6.20 m.
guardrail: Target level is not total dynamic pump head and is not an event initial groundwater condition.

claim_or_fact: De IJsvogel has three large screw pumps with combined installed capacity of 540 m3/min.
guardrail: Installed capacity is not guaranteed incremental availability and is not total OT.02 effective capacity.

claim_or_fact: Three Archimedes screws have a combined capacity of 9 m3/s.
intended_use: Independent corroboration of the 540 m3/min installed benchmark
guardrail: Secondary regional source; owner-backed source remains primary.

claim_or_fact: De Kievit is described with two electrically driven vertical screw pumps of 30 m3/min each at 1.40 m head.
guardrail: Do not equate with verified post-2020 operational Q-H curve or with the 2009 calculated hydraulic capacity.

claim_or_fact: The Kievit capacity was calculated in 2009 at 1.44 m3/s.
guardrail: Keep separate from nominal hardware capacity and current operating capacity.

claim_or_fact: The Kievit and IJsvogel underdrainage areas are coupled and form one peilgebied.
guardrail: Coupling does not imply unconstrained transfer or additive effective capacity.

claim_or_fact: During extreme conditions IJsvogel can discharge part of the water from the Kievit area.
guardrail: No default assist fraction or conveyance capacity is supported by this source; reverse routing is not established.

claim_or_fact: The under-pump installation was renovated in summer 2020; pump components, lubrication, check valves and switch cabinet were renewed and the electrical installation allows more efficient operation.
guardrail: Do not infer a numerical post-renovation efficiency or capacity without acceptance tests or telemetry.

claim_or_fact: Historical NOP SWAP/FutureView setup used 100 d as standard tile-drain resistance.
guardrail: Not a calibrated current OT.02 parameter.

claim_or_fact: Historical setup represented surface drainage with about 30 d resistance at groundwater 30 cm below surface and a drainage base 30 cm below surface.
guardrail: Mechanism prior only; do not silently transfer to current OT.02 implementation.

claim_or_fact: PDOK IMWA exposes current peilgebied features suitable for discovery of a current OT.02 candidate geometry.
guardrail: Candidate feature identity still requires explicit review against official Tollebeek context before admission.

claim_or_fact: Coordinate queries return derived/modal soil profile attributes including horizons, texture, bulk density and Staring building-block information.
guardrail: Derived/modal profile is not a direct measurement and API bulk density is not automatically current compaction state.
